versions.content: The PDU Router module shall identify routing path uniquely by the combination of source module I-PDU ID (located in the PDU Router configuration) and destination I-PDU IDs (located in the called destination module configurations).

The PDU Router module shall identify a routing path uniquely by the combination of source module I-PDU ID (located in the PDU Router configuration) and destination I-PDU IDs (located in the called destination module configurations).
